contracts.commit_point: The network commit of each Drive API request: service.files().list(...).execute() at tools.py:162-169 (list_files); service.files().create(...).execute() at tools.py:271-276 (create_file); service.files().delete(...).execute() at tools.py:335-338 (delete_file). All three commit points share one stratum (http), so a single contract covers them.
contracts.declared_mechanism: before_tool_callback registered on the LlmAgent root_agent (agent.py:54). The callback selects the guarded tools by name prefix ('list_files', 'create_file', 'delete_file', plus a redacted prefix) at callbacks.py:56-61; it permits execution only when cached credentials are valid/refreshable (callbacks.py:62-88) or an exchanged OAuth2 credential is available via tool_context.get_auth_response (callbacks.py:90-109); otherwise it calls tool_context.request_credential(AuthConfig(...)) and returns {'pending': True, 'message': 'Awaiting user authentication.'} to block the tool call (callbacks.py:111-120).
contracts.forbidden_condition: A list_files, create_file, or delete_file tool invocation committing its Google Drive API request (files().list/.create/.delete(...).execute()) while no valid OAuth2 credential is available — i.e., the before_tool_callback returning None (permitting execution) when neither cached/refreshed credentials (callbacks.py:86-88) nor an exchanged auth credential (callbacks.py:98-109) validate.
pending_binding_information: The guarded tool-name tuple includes a redacted prefix entry (callbacks.py:57) whose corresponding tool does not appear in the supplied source; whether it targets an additional guarded operation is unresolved.

Whether the ADK framework treats a non-None before_tool_callback return value as suppressing tool execution is framework behavior not shown in the supplied source; the blocking semantics at the commit point depend on it.

Whether any non-agent code path in the repository invokes list_files/create_file/delete_file directly (bypassing the callback) cannot be established or excluded from the supplied views (repository enumeration incomplete).
contracts.protected_operation: Agent-invoked execution of the list_files, create_file, and delete_file tools registered on the root LlmAgent.
contracts.protected_resource: The user's Google Drive data accessed through the Drive v3 API (file listing, file creation, file deletion) under the Drive OAuth2 scopes declared in callbacks.py:50-54.
contracts.protection_obligation: Every agent-dispatched invocation of the list_files, create_file, or delete_file tools must pass the before_tool_callback OAuth2 auth gate: the Google Drive API effect may proceed only when valid OAuth2 credentials (Drive scopes) are available; otherwise the callback must block execution, request user authentication via tool_context.request_credential, and return a pending authentication response instead of allowing the Drive API call.
scope_limits: The gate applies only to tool invocations dispatched through root_agent's before_tool_callback; no other invocation path for these tools is shown or covered in the supplied source.

The guarded set is determined by tool.name prefix matching (callbacks.py:56-61); non-matching tool names fall through to return None (callbacks.py:122). Only list_files, create_file, and delete_file are registered in the supplied source (agent.py:48-53).

The declared guard is credential-validity gating only; the supplied source declares no per-argument authorization policy (e.g., which file_id may be deleted, which MIME types may be created). Tool-internal argument validation (tools.py:112-148, 239-257, 317-321) is not part of this obligation.

The OAuth2 scheme/credential configuration (authorization/token URLs redacted) is contextual only; this contract covers the gate-before-effect obligation, not the correctness of the OAuth flow itself.

missing_information: ADK runtime semantics for before_tool_callback (whether a returned dict suppresses tool execution and is surfaced as the tool response) are not present in the supplied source; the contract records the declared registration and callback logic without deciding runtime enforcement behavior.
The identity/target of the redacted tool-name prefix at callbacks.py:57 is unsupported by supplied source.
Repository enumeration is incomplete and behavior labels are unavailable; presence or absence of alternative invocation paths to the guarded tools cannot be determined from the supplied views.
